review.change: Queue public operations consistently resolve the store root before comparing persisted plan paths, writing pins, globbing reservations or producing worker receipts.
review.coverage: The new regression admits a DAG by absolute path, then exercises CLI initialize/status/tick/work with a relative --root. It also exercises relative API enqueue/tick/status/work and CLI enqueue idempotency against the same store.
review.independent_test: The focused relative-root regression passed 1/1 in 1.385 seconds.
review.author_suite: The full synthetic queue suite passed 24/24 in 12.147 seconds.
review.v3_recipe: The fresh v3 plan and invocation pin the final queue source SHA. Both queued job specifications also include that exact experiment_queue.py input pin. The dedicated v3 store, worker output, and both v3 job output directories did not exist at review time.
review.prior_failure: The v2 timeout/quarantine evidence remains present and unchanged; its store is separate from the fresh v3 recipe.
